name: Sherlock
description: Sherlock is an open-source Python command-line tool that hunts for a given username across 400+ social networks and websites, reporting confirmed profile URLs.
gating_notes: Fully open-source (MIT license), installed via pip/pipx/Docker; no signup, API key, or account is required to use the core tool since it performs unauthenticated queries against public sites.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server from the sherlock-project maintainers. Multiple unofficial/community MCP servers exist, e.g. github.com/Burnsedia/sherlock-mcp (FastMCP wrapper) and several third-party Apify actors exposing Sherlock-like username search via MCP/API endpoints — these are independent projects, not published or endorsed by sherlock-project.
blocker: Sherlock is a local CLI/Python tool, not a hosted REST/GraphQL API — there is no official HTTP endpoint to call. A Composio toolkit would have to shell out to the CLI (or embed the library) and directly scrape hundreds of third-party sites, which is fragile, rate-limit prone, and only unofficial MCP/API wrappers exist today.
